blurb: R-Wild Horse Ranch is a private, family-oriented recreational property with 14,080 acres in Northern California's Shasta Cascade. Owners have access year-round to horseback riding, fishing, hiking, RV camping, swimming, off-road trails, and many other outdoor activities. The ranch includes cabins, RV hookups, motel rooms, pools, and various amenities for owners and their guests.
extraNote: Group reservations over 6 guests must be requested and approved prior to arrival · Visitors who are not owners or invited guests will not be admitted · Check in at the main security gate on Highway 36 · Open 365 days a year
